summary: Vance County tower; a Robesonian report dated December 1952 describes a 100-foot tower one mile north of Henderson. No current status found.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources
facts.status_note: No source found says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: Robesonian report dated 1952-12-03, as quoted by the lookout-history site, says the tower was constructed by then. No construction date is given.

evidence.supports: Robesonian report dated December 3, 1952: 100-foot tower constructed one mile north of Henderson in Vance County
evidence.quote: December 3, 1952: One 100-foot tower was constructed one mile north of Henderson in Vance county.

evidence.supports: agency is the NC Division of Forest Resources
evidence.quote: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: list places tower at 36.357 N, 78.371 W in Vance County

notes_for_editor: Only two secondhand sources. The 1952 construction report is known only as quoted by the Weebly lookout-history page; The Robesonian itself was not reached. Status, staffing, fires, access and fate are all unsourced. The tnlandforms list (revised 2021) gives coordinates 36.35666,-78.37083, which the editor may want to check against the 1952 'one mile north of Henderson' wording. Not on the NHLR North Carolina list or the FFLOS North Carolina list. Do not confuse with the 1908 Henderson Fire Station and Municipal Building on Garnett Street, which is a different structure.
